gchat.sense: noun: Alternative letter-case form of Gchat.

firstUse.quote: 2:40 p.m.: Surprise gchat from hot lawyer I met at a work event a few weeks ago. We’ve been trying to grab drinks again, but our schedules haven’t matched up. He wants to see me tonight.
firstUse.source: 2010 October 4, “The Horny Single Gay Guy Wondering If All NYC Gays (Except Him) Are in Open Relationships”, in Intelligencer, New York, N.Y.: New York Media, a
